text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and structured “Firstly/Secondly/Thirdly” organization","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a deliberate, easy-to-follow structure with clear paragraph progression and signposting."},{"evidence":"“Confidence involves having trust and believing that you are capable”","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows more control of complex sentence patterns and explanatory syntax."},{"evidence":"“I have found that when I set high goals…” repeated throughout","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay develops each point with sustained explanation rather than brief, repetitive assertion."},{"evidence":"“For example, at school… varsity tennis team” and “honors or academic”","quality":"relevant elaboration","description":"The essay supports claims with more specific, well-connected examples that are tied back to the main point."},{"evidence":"“benefits me more to set high expectations and not reach my goal”","quality":"academic register","description":"The essay uses a more formal and essay-like tone with fewer conversational or awkward phrasing choices."},{"evidence":"“progress my abilities further,” “learn and flourish,” “continue learning”","quality":"precise word choice","description":"The essay uses vocabulary more accurately and with clearer meaning in discussing growth and achievement."},{"evidence":"“Despite not making it onto the team… I actually greatly improved”","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay more effectively connects causes, outcomes, and conclusions within and across paragraphs."}]}
